title: Long-Tail Knowledge in Large Language Models: Taxonomy, Mechanisms, Interventions and Implications

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing prior evaluations of model performance, safety, and task adherence on low-resource languages, non-standard dialects (e.g., African American Vernacular English), and code-switching, utilizing benchmarks like ReDial and analyzing tokenization-induced sparsity.

Reviewing empirical studies and benchmarks (such as CPopQA, CANDLE, CAMeL, and BLEnD) to measure disparity in accuracy, hallucination rates, and value alignment between Western/Global North (WEIRD) entities and underrepresented non-Western cultures.
Evaluating literature on model performance degradation regarding historical facts with low contemporary digital presence (the 'Forgotten Past') versus highly represented modern web text.
